title: Frontend NSFW filtering removed
summary:
A frontend filter came out, social preview images got wired in, and text-response referral selection changed.

The frontend no longer filters content on the basis of its NSFW classification. This change is specific to the frontend.

Referral matching now considers both input messages and generated text. The selection probabilities for referral links and the Ko-fi fallback were also adjusted, alongside additions to Pollinator Agent integration tracking.

Pages now include image metadata for social previews, with duplicate Open Graph and Twitter tags removed. Site logo, banner, and touch-icon assets were updated too.
